# FG-AUTH-0016

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 403 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `csrf_rejections_name_their_reason` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: この操作は受け付けられませんでした。ページを再読み込みしてから、もう一度実行してください。
- en: This action was not accepted. Reload the page and try again.
- id: Tindakan ini tidak diterima. Muat ulang halaman lalu coba lagi.

## 原因 (cause)

A state-changing request (not GET, HEAD or OPTIONS) failed the cross-site request checks (ADR-0021 §6, M2 MR3). Two checks run independently: (1) any request that carries fetch metadata (Sec-Fetch-Site / -Mode / -Dest) or an Origin header — whatever its credentials, Bearer and anonymous included — must have `Sec-Fetch-Site: same-origin` when present and an `Origin` exactly equal to the origin of web.base_url; (2) a request authenticated by anything but `Authorization: Bearer` on the API or raw / archive (in practice the session cookie `__Host-gstn_session`) must also send `Origin` and the header `X-GitStation-CSRF` with the session's CSRF token (HMAC-SHA256 of the cookie's secret; `GET /api/v1/session` returns it). git Smart HTTP gets check (1) only (git sends neither header).

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event `forge.auth.csrf_rejected` carries `reason`: token_missing (no X-GitStation-CSRF header), token_mismatch (not this session's token — another session's, an old page's after a new sign-in, or a forged one), origin_missing (a session request without Origin), origin_mismatch (Origin is another origin: another subdomain, http vs https, another port; with `expected_origin`; `base_url=unset` when web.base_url is not configured), fetch_site (Sec-Fetch-Site was same-site, cross-site or none). It also carries `method`, `path` (log-safe) and, for a session, `public_id`. Header values are never logged except the expected origin. A burst of origin_mismatch from one client usually means a page of another site posting to GitStation (an attack or a misconfigured integration); a single token_mismatch after a new sign-in is a stale tab.

## 対処 (fix)

For a person: reload the page (it fetches the current CSRF token) and repeat the action. For an integration or script: authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <token>` and do not send browser headers (Origin / Sec-Fetch-*) from another origin. If every browser request fails with origin_mismatch, check that web.base_url is exactly the URL people open (scheme, host and port).
